name: DataGrid
summary: A virtualized grid that sorts, filters and resizes columns over the rows it receives, with single or multiple selection.
usage: Use for lists of records that people scan, sort and filter in the browser; DataSet adds the CRUD toolbar and form. Give each column a value to sort and filter by. Sorting and filtering apply to the rows passed in, so a paginated caller sorts and filters only the loaded page; server-side sorting and filtering are not provided. Keep rows and columns stable between renders. Selection stays caller-owned. Pass exportName to offer Excel, CSV and PDF exports of the rows shown.
accessibility: Uses role=grid with aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex, so assistive technology knows the full size while only the rows in view are rendered. Rows expose aria-selected (aria-multiselectable with multiple) and form one tab stop: arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End move between rows, Enter activates and Space selects. Column headers expose aria-sort; their sort button, options Menu and a separator that Left/Right arrows resize are keyboard reachable, and the options appear on hover or focus. A live status reports the shown, total and selected counts. The Export menu is a labeled Menu; it is busy while a file is prepared, and a failure is announced as an alert.

props.name: locale
props.meaning: Language of the grid labels, sorting and number formatting.

props.name: rows
props.meaning: All rows to show. Keep the array stable between renders.

props.name: columns
props.meaning: Stable key and header; value enables sorting and filtering, render overrides the formatted value, format names values, and width, minWidth, align, sortable, filterable and resizable tune the column. Keep the array stable between renders.

props.name: selectedId / onSelect
props.meaning: The current row. With single selection it is the highlighted row; clicking a row or moving with the arrow keys calls onSelect.

props.name: multiple
props.meaning: Allows choosing several rows: Ctrl/⌘ toggles a row, Shift selects a range, Space toggles the focused row and Ctrl/⌘+A selects every shown row.

props.name: selectedIds / onSelectedIdsChange
props.meaning: Caller-owned multiple selection; used only with multiple.

props.name: onRowActivate
props.meaning: Double-click or Enter on a row.

props.name: exportName
props.meaning: Offers an Export menu in the footer with Excel (.xlsx), CSV and PDF files of the rows the grid shows, in their order and with its filters; the name titles the files. Omit it where records must not leave the screen.

props.name: empty
props.meaning: Shown instead of the grid when there are no rows.

states: Filtered, with the filter shown on the header
Many rows (only those in view rendered)

examples.label: Ten thousand rows
examples.description: Synthetic screens generated locally; the example passes multiple, so Ctrl/⌘ and Shift choose several rows, and exportName, so the footer exports them. Sorting, filtering, resizing and exports make no request.
examples.code:
<DataGrid label="Screens" locale="en-US" rows={screens} columns={columns} rowId={(row) => row.id}
  multiple selectedIds={selected} onSelectedIdsChange={setSelected} exportName="Screens" />
